title: How To Sell Anything To Anyone Online (I Spent $1M Learning This)
promo_conflict: The whole video promotes Codie Sanchez's new book, its virtual book-launch event (with a $1M cash-and-prizes giveaway and a $47 VIP upgrade), the ownerscore.com lead magnet and sign-ups via the description link. The ads and metrics shown are her own launch campaign.

stated_problem.quote: if you need to hire more, but your margins won't cover it, this video is for you.
stated_problem.speaker: Codie Sanchez

idea.name: Contrarian Thinking info/education business (book launch funnel)
idea.one_liner: Personal-brand business education company. It uses free lead magnets, a free virtual book-launch event and giveaways to collect emails, then upsells a $47 VIP upgrade and higher-ticket direct work.
idea.customer: Small business owners and aspiring owners who want more cash and freedom
idea.offer: Books, free virtual live events, lead magnets (Owner Score personality test), templates/playbooks, paid VIP upgrades and high-ticket advisory
idea.revenue_model: Free-to-paid ladder: email opt-in, then a $47 VIP upgrade, then high-ticket work 'with us directly'. Also book sales and evergreen video sales pages.

key_quotes.quote: I'm going to give you the exact strategy, which I call the 6M's, that I've never shared outside my company.
You could register without buying anything only after someone had already clicked yes and registered.
This is how you move someone from ticket to a high ticket item.
You always want to own your connection to the customer and you want their emails, you want their addresses, you want to be able to text them.
So a secret hack, run ads on Amazon to your book later.
Historically, the ads with Chris convert better than the ads without Chris

claims.claim: Spent over $1M in 90 days learning the strategy
claims.quote: I just spent over a million dollars in the past 90 days learning what I am about to tell you in this video.

claims.claim: Giving away $1M in cash and prizes at the launch event
claims.quote: Once that means I am literally giving a million dollars in cash and prizes away for free.

claims.claim: Spent hundreds of thousands of dollars on the Owner Score lead magnet
claims.quote: I also spent hundreds of thousands of dollars making a lead magnet called the owner score.

claims.claim: Free registration is followed by a $47 VIP upgrade
claims.quote: Did we offer them the next step of $47 VIP upgrade?
76% of people who had previously complied with the smaller yes, later agreed to a larger yes

claims.claim: Six CTA rules nearly tripled conversions
claims.quote: So I gave my employees six more rules that nearly tripled our conversions just by CTAs.

claims.claim: People need 24-30 touches before they show up to an event
claims.quote: We think you need 24 to 30 times to show up for an event.

claims.claim: Using 'your' in a CTA gives 2-3x higher click-through rate
claims.quote: When you use the words your, you get somewhere between a two and three X higher click through rate across ads.

claims.claim: Gross margin per customer should be at least 2-3x CAC ($30 margin means $10 CAC or less)
claims.quote: If you make 30 bucks of gross margin on a customer, I want to acquire them for 10 bucks or less
And it got 4,000 shares and 1200 people signed up.

claims.claim: Book launch reveal video: 2.4M views, 30k likes, thousands of sign-ups
claims.quote: We did a book launch reveal and it got 2.4 million views, 30,000 likes and signed up thousands of people for the book launch.

claims.claim: Reveal video cost about $50-60 in props
claims.quote: It took about two seconds to film and I think probably 50, 60 bucks for all of this stuff that was inside of it.
If you want the exact playbooks and templates we use to grow our nine figure businesses, sign up at the link below.

acquisition_channels.details: Runs paid ads using exclusivity, self-referencing ('if you X, this is for you') and gift hooks. Suggests Amazon ads on competing business books.

Instagram captions, reels, carousels and YouTube videos with long, clear CTAs ('Comment own'). Uses trend-jacking videos (40th birthday, gender-reveal parody) and a 90/60/30/10 launch content calendar with a mascot (Oxo).

Free lead magnets (ownerscore.com personality test, ad-ranking spreadsheet) and a free virtual live event with a $1M giveaway to collect emails. Then email nurture and evergreen video sales landing pages.

ideas.delivery: Codie Sanchez and her team deliver content, books, virtual live events and advisory. Marketing is run by an in-house team.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and PECR apply to the email/SMS lists: marketing texts and emails to individuals need prior consent or a soft opt-in. Large giveaways must follow UK prize-promotion rules (Gambling Act 2005 free-entry requirements, CAP Code). Any recurring VIP or membership subscriptions fall under the DMCC Act subscription rules.

claims.quote: More than 5,000 business owners inside of our scaling advisory firm

idea.name: Traditional book publisher
idea.one_liner: Publisher pays authors an advance plus small royalties, and owns distribution and the customer relationship.
idea.revenue_model: Book sales margin; the author keeps only 10-15%

key_quotes.quote: the publisher pays you a big advance upfront and then gives you royalties on the books itself, but like a tiny little itty bit.
They own the direct to customer relationship, the distribution, the customer data.

claims.claim: Codie turned down millions in publishing deals
claims.quote: I gave up millions in publishing deals from one of the biggest publishers in the world

claims.claim: In traditional publishing the author keeps 10-15%
claims.quote: Traditional publishing, the author might keep 10 to 15 percent.

ideas.delivery: Publisher handles printing, distribution and retail

idea.name: Contrarian Thinking Press (self-publishing)
idea.one_liner: Own small publishing imprint that self-publishes the founder's books. It keeps 40-50% margin and the customer data, and sells through live-event launches and ads.
idea.revenue_model: Book sales at 40-50% margin after costs, plus backend offers to captured emails

key_quotes.quote: That's 3x higher, which is why we have our own little publisher now, contrarian thinking press right here.
Its extra margin gives a ton of room to spend more to acquire a customer.
more creators and more authors who have big audiences are switching to a live event release and self-publishing, because you own the audience.

claims.quote: With the self publishing model, we were looking at keeping roughly 40 to 50 percent after the costs of all this stuff like the books.

claims.claim: About 3x the margin of traditional publishing
claims.quote: That's 3x higher, which is why we have our own little publisher now, contrarian thinking press right here.

acquisition_channels.details: Founder audience, live virtual launch event, social content
Extra margin funds ads, including Amazon ads on books

ideas.delivery: In-house press produces the books; printing and fulfilment presumably outsourced
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and PECR consent for the buyer email/SMS lists it is built to capture.
